authoring_guidance: Help the traveler choose among meaningfully different options. Use concise narrative and exact reference blocks; the application supplies flight facts, prices and booking caveats. Choose useful distinct journeys rather than multiple nearly identical feeder variants. Briefly discuss a notable unselected cabin or routing alternative when it changes the decision. Compare complete local dates, cabin evidence and observed money conservatively. Do not claim full-pool cheapest from incomplete observed prices; heuristic comparison cost is not payable cash. Keep the direct cash benchmark separate. When no complete journey qualifies, state that plainly and describe incomplete observations only as potential leads, never recommendations. Internal eligibility labels, requirement checklists, opaque IDs and repetitive factual paragraphs do not belong in narrative. Unknowns remain unknown; never imply current availability, protected connections or a complete party price without evidence. Declare material scoped claims only when their exact text appears in the same block.
